title: Boli zainab chali kahaa'n amma
body:
Boli zainab chali kahaa'n amma
Chord ko hum ko neemjaa'n amma
Bhai shabbar pachaadei'n kha kha kar
Poochte hai gayi kahaa'n amma
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhai sarwar ka dam na ghut jaaye
Kab se karte hai wo fughaa'n amma
Aaj bin maa ki ho gayi'n afsos
Teri dukhiyaari betiyaa'n amma
<<DIVIDER>>
Saath apne hamei'n bhi le chaliye
Aap jaati hai ab jahaa'n amma
Uth gaya sar se aap ka saaya
Log ab denge ghurkiyaa'n amma
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhooliyega na isko mehshar
Hai sa'eed apna nouhakhwaa'n amma
